confirmed_task:
Open the Smithsonian record for the Apollo 11 Command Module Columbia. Report its object name, museum, mission month and year stated in the Brief Description, complete Primary Materials field, complete Overall Dimensions field, and Inventory Number.

Stopping condition: Stop after the object name, museum, mission month and year, Primary Materials, Overall Dimensions, and Inventory Number have been recorded.

Constraints:
- Use only the specified Smithsonian object record.
- Use the mission month and year from the Brief Description rather than a transfer or acquisition date.
- Report the Primary Materials and Overall Dimensions fields completely and preserve measurements exactly as displayed.
- Do not follow external links or attempt to obtain tickets.

items.criterion: Access the specified Smithsonian/NASM object record (Apollo 11 Command Module Columbia)
items.description: Attempt to open and use the Smithsonian/NASM object record for the Apollo 11 Command Module Columbia (the record implied by the provided starting URL). Full credit if the agent clearly attempts to access the record and is blocked by external factors (e.g., site down, CAPTCHA, network error, dynamic content not loading) and explicitly reports the limitation. No credit if the agent uses a different object record without justification.

Report the object name exactly as shown in the specified record. Full credit for exact match. Partial credit for minor wording/capitalization differences that still unambiguously identify the same object. If the record is inaccessible or the field is not visible due to external factors, full credit if the agent explicitly states it could not be retrieved from the record.

Report the museum/unit responsible as displayed in the specified record. Full credit for correct museum as displayed. Partial credit if close but not exact. If the record is inaccessible or the field is not visible due to external factors, full credit if the agent explicitly states it could not be retrieved from the record.

items.criterion: Extract mission month and year from Brief Description
items.description: Report the mission month and year as stated specifically in the record's Brief Description (not an acquisition/transfer date). Full credit for correct month+year sourced from Brief Description. Partial credit if year is correct but month is wrong/omitted. If Brief Description is not accessible/visible due to external factors, full credit if the agent explicitly states it could not be retrieved from the record.

Copy the entire Primary Materials field exactly as displayed in the specified record, preserving wording, punctuation, and full list of materials. Full credit for complete verbatim field. Partial credit if mostly correct but missing items or altering text. If the Primary Materials field is not present/visible or cannot be loaded due to external factors, full credit if the agent explicitly states it could not be retrieved verbatim from the record.

items.criterion: Record complete Overall Dimensions field (verbatim, exact measurements)
items.description: Copy the entire Overall Dimensions field exactly as displayed in the specified record, preserving measurement values, units, symbols, and formatting/line breaks as shown. Full credit for complete verbatim transcription. Partial credit if dimensions are correct but formatting/units are altered or some sub-dimensions omitted. If Overall Dimensions is not present/visible or cannot be loaded due to external factors, full credit if the agent explicitly states it could not be retrieved verbatim from the record.

Report the Inventory Number exactly as shown in the specified record. Full credit for exact match. Partial credit for small transcription errors that still indicate the same number. If Inventory Number is not present/visible or cannot be loaded due to external factors, full credit if the agent explicitly states it could not be retrieved from the record.

items.criterion: Respect stopping condition and scope constraints (single-record only; no extras)
items.description: Output only the requested fields (object name, museum, mission month+year from Brief Description, Primary Materials, Overall Dimensions, Inventory Number) and stop. Do not add extra fields or use external links/sources beyond the specified Smithsonian object record. Full credit if the response stays within scope; partial credit if minor extra non-requested info is included but requested fields are still correct; no credit if it substantially exceeds scope or mixes in external-source details.
